message.content: {"answer": "D", "option_text": "Low-grade B-cell Lymphoma of Bronchus-Associated Lymphoid Tissue (BALT Lymphoma)", "reason": "The chest radiograph demonstrates bilateral, multifocal, patchy airspace opacities and consolidations with a somewhat nodular or mass-like appearance, particularly in the mid-to-lower lung zones.
